description: Answer a factual question using web search, optionally shaped into a flat JSON object of fields, with sources and citations. Suited to bounded, factual answers such as a company's founding year or a product's current price. Lists of items on a live page, such as the latest blog posts, come back more reliably from scraping that page.

json.description: Optional shape for the answer: a flat JSON object of the fields you want. Example: { "book_title": "", "author": "", "release_date": "" }. Keep it flat. Deeply nested shapes or long lists are unreliable.

task.description: Question or task to answer using web data.

name: answers
title: Answers
